definitions.name: Retrieve Qdrant Point
definitions.documentation: Retrieve Qdrant Point. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. definitions.documentation: Delete Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_POINTS. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. definitions.documentation: Delete Qdrant Payload Index. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_INDEX. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. definitions.documentation:
Update Qdrant Collection. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_COLLECTION. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Upsert Qdrant Points (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Upsert Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPSERT_POINTS. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. definitions.name: Update Qdrant Vectors (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Update Qdrant Vectors. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_VECTORS. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

definitions.name: Scroll Qdrant Points (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Scroll Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

definitions.name: Count Qdrant Points (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Count Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Query Qdrant Points (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Query Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Batch Query Qdrant Points (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Batch Query Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

Group Qdrant Query Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

definitions.name: Facet Qdrant Payload (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Facet Qdrant Payload. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

definitions.name: Create Qdrant Payload Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Qdrant Payload Index. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_INDEX. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Explicit HTTPS origin only, optional root slash; no paths, userinfo, query or fragment.

definitions.documentation:
Update Qdrant Aliases. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_ALIASES. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Delete Qdrant Collection Snapshot. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_SNAPSHOT. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. definitions.documentation:
Delete Qdrant Storage Snapshot. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_STORAGE_SNAPSHOT. Point update status acknowledged or wait_timeout is not completion; inspect the returned status and reconcile state manually before another write. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qdrant/qdrant/master/docs/redoc/master/openapi.json https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/points/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/filtering/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/vectors/ https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/snapshots/ https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/search/query-points/
